description: Configure VSCode keybindings to replicate IntelliJ IDEA shortcuts. Add these five keybindings to ~/.config/Code/User/keybindings.json: (1) 'ctrl+alt+l' maps to 'editor.action.formatDocument', (2) 'ctrl+b' maps to 'editor.action.revealDefinition', (3) 'alt+f7' maps to 'references-view.findReferences', (4) 'ctrl+alt+o' maps to 'editor.action.organizeImports', (5) 'ctrl+alt+m' maps to 'editor.action.refactor'. Each keybinding should be a JSON object with 'key' and 'command' fields. Use Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) -> 'Preferences: Open Keyboard Shortcuts (JSON)' to edit the file, or use the Keyboard Shortcuts UI (Ctrl+K Ctrl+S).
